scope: Acceptance of unchanged common SPE build foundation across four concurrent clean sbuild jobs; no unrelated source changes.

deferred_foundation_candidates.gcc-14: Frozen SPE compiler is GCC8.5; do not silently switch compiler/runtime base
deferred_foundation_candidates.gcc-defaults: Requires GCC14 port; retain actual frozen SDK until reviewed compiler restoration
deferred_foundation_candidates.java-common: No SPE OpenJDK runtime/default selection; retain failed build, native Java tools remain installed

deferred_scope_candidates.apache2: Not selected for the desktop image; appears through AppArmor Apache-module build requirements. Review the base library bootstrap before adding a target web server build.
deferred_scope_candidates.apr: Apache-module chain; not an independently selected base desktop library.
deferred_scope_candidates.gem2deb: Ruby packaging helper; review native role instead of automatically porting a Ruby toolchain.
deferred_scope_candidates.ruby3.3: No selected desktop runtime requires Ruby at this stage; base C libraries use their supported bootstrap profiles when necessary.
deferred_scope_candidates.sphinx: Native documentation helper is already provisioned; no further target documentation-tool port is selected.
deferred_scope_candidates.gobject-introspection: Review native generator versus required target library role before scheduling this chain.
deferred_scope_candidates.systemtap: Do not build a target tracing suite automatically; establish any required SDK/header-only output first.
